author: Ted Schwerzler
title: KOC Keeping Minnesota Vikings QBs in the Dark Too - NewsBreak
text:
By Ted Schwerzler ,
6 hours ago
The Minnesota Vikings held their first training camp practice Wednesday , putting Kevin O’Connell’s quarterback competition under the spotlight. When it will end remains anyone’s guess, apparently even for the players involved.
We’ve heard several different timelines , while those with firsthand knowledge have offered opinions on who should win. Whether or not you believe the competition is legitimate, O’Connell appears intent on keeping the charade going for a while.
Kyler Murray uncertain about MN Vikings QB timeline The Minnesota Vikings landed Kyler Murray for just $1.3 million because Arizona is still on the hook for more than $36 million owed to him. Getting a seven-year veteran and former first overall pick for that compensation is crazy. With J.J. McCarthy in the building, though, Minnesota is determined to see the process through.
It’s difficult to imagine McCarthy beating out Murray for the Vikings’ starting job based on their respective track records. Still, O’Connell told reporters Tuesday that he has an ideal date in mind for naming his starter. He declined to reveal it but said the reps don’t need to be divided evenly for both quarterbacks to receive a fair opportunity.
Despite O’Connell having a target date, Murray said Wednesday that he hasn’t been given a timeline for the decision. Asked about it after the first practice, he left everything in his coach’s hands.
“For me I think it’s a reps thing. Continue to do it over and over again. Say it over and over again. The more you do it, the more you say it, the more it comes natural the more it comes easier. I think that’s really the process for me. Once all that settles down, for me, it’s just about playing football.”
Kyler Murray on learning the Vikings system “I mean honestly, that’s up to KO. Like I said, I’m focused on today. I’m not looking too much in the future. Again, just trying to come out here and put my best foot forward each and every day.”
Kyler Murray on a potential QB competition timeline If something could hold Murray back, it’s his lack of familiarity with O’Connell’s system. Splitting first-team reps limits his opportunity to acclimate, but it’s a tradeoff the head coach appears comfortable with for now.
Murray has 87 games of NFL experience, but he is learning a new offense. McCarthy has played only 10 games , though he has spent two years learning O’Connell’s system. If Murray is ultimately going to win the job, the sooner O’Connell puts the veteran in the driver’s seat and allows him to settle in with the first-team offense, the better positioned Minnesota should be.
The Minnesota Vikings open their preseason schedule Aug. 15 and begin the regular season Sept. 13 against the Green Bay Packers. Giving the eventual starter enough time to become comfortable before then seems like the obvious choice.
